tldcoop_trees.bundle is the texture asset bundle ("dynamictrees") of DynamicTrees
(https://github.com/Fuar11/DynamicTrees), by Fuar, The Illusion and Jods-Its (textures by Jods-Its),
Copyright (c) 2023-2024. It has no published licence; it is included in TLDCoop_DLC, and the mod's logic
ported to C++ (src/dynamic_trees.cpp, src/trees_math.h), with the authors' permission (obtained by
cgpt28641-ops, 30.10.2026). Source commit: see `git log` of the upstream repository at the time of copying.
Do not redistribute this file separately from TLDCoop_DLC without the authors' permission.

TLDCoop_DLC change (04.11.2026): the snowy pine/cedar sets (Lowest..Highest) blended back towards the Clear set
(tools/trees/tone_snow.py, K=0.55) so the needles keep their green under the snow.
TLDCoop_DLC change (04.11.2026, later): all pine/cedar sets remade from the original (tools/trees/realistic.py):
bark recoloured to bark colours (pine grey-brown, cedar red-brown) from its own light and shade, snow on it kept;
branch cards' snow in clumps on top of the needles, the green between, per snow state.
